body.what: forward paper log of ATM straddle SELECTION by the frozen size forecast vs the option market's implied move, against a twin selected by trailing volatility. No broker, no orders, no LLM.

inputs.bars: backend/data/optimus/prices_2025_26/bars.parquet (Alpaca SIP, adjustment=all, refreshed nightly by scripts/pull_bars_refresh.py); decision close = its newest session
inputs.earnings: yfinance earnings calendar: report dates strictly before the pull time only; the next-earnings flag is the POINT-IN-TIME projection (last done report + 91-day steps), never the actual future report date
inputs.chains: yfinance option_chain (free, delayed ~15 min); the underlying quote from the same call
inputs.market: SPY from the bars file (2-day abnormal earnings moves)

body.universe: top 400 bars symbols by 63-session median dollar volume at the decision close, price >= $5, known ETFs/index proxies excluded, underlying quoteType EQUITY
body.expiry_rule: the standard monthly (third Friday, or the session before it) with calendar DTE in [21, 35] on the entry day; no such expiry -> no entry that day (OBSERVE_ONLY snapshot)
body.entry: one entry per XNYS session, first scheduled pass in 10:45-15:30 America/New_York; strike = the listed strike nearest spot carried by both a call and a put

quote_filters.refuse: zero/missing bid or ask, crossed quotes, unpriceable mid (IV outside band)

body.implied_move: iv_atm = mean of call and put IV inverted from the MID (European BSM, r = 0.04, q = 0); implied move = iv_atm * sqrt(T_to_expiry_close) * sqrt(2/pi)
body.ranking: gap = log(forecast E|r21| * sqrt(sessions_to_expiry / 21) / implied move); LONG = largest gaps, SHORT = smallest; ties by symbol; a cell needs >= 2*breadth + 10 usable names
body.primary_breadth: 100 per leg if that cell ran (>= 210 usable names) on >= 80% of the entry sessions in the read; otherwise 50 per leg. Declared before the first entry because the 2026-09-28 closing-quote dry run had 164 usable of 400 (the 100 cell could not run); mechanical, not chosen after a result.
body.twin: the SAME usable names on the SAME quotes, ranked by trailing 63-session vol * sqrt(21/252) * sqrt(2/pi) instead of the ridge
body.fill_convention: LONG straddle bought at call ask + put ask; SHORT sold at call bid + put bid
body.exit: held to expiry; marked at INTRINSIC |S_T - K| from the bars close on the expiry session (split-rescaled, dividends not); no exit cost charged (sensitivity: 5% of intrinsic)
body.costs: the quoted spread paid at entry (ask for longs, bid for shorts); nothing assumed
body.objective: log utility of equity with 2% of equity in premium per leg: log(1 + b*ls_ridge) - log(1 + b*ls_vol), ls = (long + short)/2 return on premium; secondary: the ridge L/S vs cash at quoted costs
body.statistics: one observation per EXPIRY (cohorts sharing an expiry averaged); t / SE / MDE = 2.8 SE over expiry blocks (move_size_sizing.block_stats, block_len 1)

power.history: 2014-2024 100/leg diff +8.2 bp of equity/month, monthly sd ~19.5 bp (se 1.72 bp x 3 x sqrt(43 blocks) / sqrt 3)
power.note: the forward universe is ~300-400 names, so 100/leg is ~a tercile (the lab's 100/leg was ~6% of 1,755 names; its quintile cell was +6.8 bp, t 5.28). A forward confirmation at the historical effect needs ~44 expiries (~3.7 years).

body.kill_rule: from 6 expiry blocks, at every grade: if the PRIMARY-cell diff has mean <= 0 and t <= -1 (FAILED_VARIANT) the selector is RETIRED_FROM_CURRENT_SEARCH. At 6 blocks (SE ~8 bp) the rule fires on a true zero with ~16% chance per look and on the historical +8.2 bp with ~2%: it detects a reversal, it cannot confirm.
body.first_read: after 12 graded expiry blocks (MDE ~15.8 bp, about twice the historical effect): report, do not promote
body.promotion: none from this contract. CAPITAL_CANDIDATE needs matured forward evidence AND a defined-risk form (long straddles only, or short legs wrapped in wings).

code_at_freeze.note: every SESSION row records the code hashes it ran; a decision-changing edit is a new contract version

body.first_entry_session: the first XNYS session with a standard monthly 21-35 calendar days out (from 2026-09-29: 2026-10-16 -> the 2026-11-20 expiry)
body.first_grade: the 2026-11-20 expiry close, graded on the first scheduled pass after the nightly bars refresh carries that session
body.worst_case: printed on every snapshot for the ridge short leg at 3 and 10 sigma, $1,000,000 notional
